column1: # Curated 1ND0A function-name registry – the reverse-engineering source of truth tracked in git.
# RenameFuncs.java applies it to the Ghidra project; ExportGraph.java then writes the names
# to funcs.csv -> load_graph.py -> Memgraph. An edit here updates both consumers.
